title: Game development
author: charmander447
selftext:
Hello everyone I have been working on an RPG game for the last month during my free time, and I’m starting to reach the point where I’m burning three tickets and my game file is 1.5MB. I am using Claude code. My game is getting close to the point where I need to add like 400 images for all of my items. I’m not sure how to add them with out breaking Claude 😂 any advice on how to add all of these pngs. 

(Also my game is a react file and I have multiple jsx files separating all of my different systems, items, quest, locations etc.

comments.author: fued
comments.body:
do it manually

  
If you make AI do everything, you are going to spend more tokens than you will ever get back at the moment honestly

replies.author: GTTGgames
replies.body: actually good idea - I do some manual work to with folders and assets and creating stuff outside the claude code environment

comments.author: CycleMother2006
comments.body:
AI doesn't need to read picture data to move them around or organize them. If you just request for a directory of files to be sorted into your project and assigned to a manifest or something it costs nothing. If, on the other hand, you ask it to look at a 5mb picture or just a ton of smaller images, yes you are going to get it frozen and/or use an excessive amount of tokens as it processes all of them with a vision model. 

Alternatively, manually drag them in yourself. But imo AI is pretty good at bulk file management as long as you give it direct instructions, and the time it saves is quite meaningful.

comments.author: AdmirableJudgment784
comments.body: Depends on the type of images. Go with Google Ultra for $100/month that would allow for unlimited image generation. I have the $200/month plaan because I generate around 200 images per day.
